title.zh: 快要毕业时，一百个留学生被叫回国
title.en: Called Home Before Graduation: China's Students in America, 1872–1881

dek.zh: 一百二十个孩子被派去美国，计划读十五年。第九年，约一百人被召回。叫停他们的不是一件事，而是一连串报告、拒绝、奏折与征询。
dek.en: A hundred and twenty boys were sent to America for fifteen years of study. In the ninth year, about a hundred were called home. No single event stopped them; a chain of reports, a refusal, a memorial and a consultation did.

preheader.zh: 一封“没有位置”的回信，一份御史的奏折，和一个晚了七年才修铁路的耶鲁毕业生。
preheader.en: A one-line refusal, a censor's memorial, and a Yale graduate who waited seven years to build railways.

paras.zh: 1870年代末，容闳为几名学业已经足够好的中国留学生，向美国国务院申请进入西点军校和安纳波利斯海军学院。答复只有一句：“没有为中国学生准备的位置。”容闳后来写道，他把这次碰壁报告给李鸿章，李的回信让他立刻明白，这个计划的命运已经注定。
paras.en: In the late 1870s Yung Wing applied to the State Department for some of the Chinese students, by now far enough along in their studies, to enter the Military Academy at West Point and the Naval Academy at Annapolis. The answer was one line: "There is no room provided for Chinese students." When he reported the rebuff to Li Hongzhang, Yung later wrote, the reply "at once convinced me that the fate of the Mission was sealed".

paras.zh: 1881年，大约一百名学生被召回国。耶鲁校长波特等人联名致信总理衙门，说这些年轻人恰在“就要从此前的学业中收获最重要成果”的时候被带走。
paras.en: In 1881 about a hundred students were called home. President Porter of Yale and others wrote to the Zongli Yamen, China's foreign office, that the young men had been taken away "just at the time when they were about to reap the most important advantages from their previous studies".

paras.zh: 这个计划始于同治十一年正月（1872年）：两江总督曾国藩、直隶总督李鸿章奏请挑选幼童赴美肄业，由陈兰彬和容闳管理学生、常驻美国。按容闳的记述，计划共送一百二十人，分四批、每年三十人；年龄十二到十五岁；家长要签字，同意孩子出洋读书十五年。1872年夏末，第一批三十人准备横渡太平洋。
paras.en: The programme began in the first month of the eleventh year of Tongzhi (1872), when Zeng Guofan, Viceroy of Liangjiang, and Li Hongzhang, Viceroy of Zhili, asked the throne to send selected boys to study in America, with Chen Lanbin and Yung Wing to manage them and live in the United States. By Yung Wing's account the plan was for 120 boys in four groups of 30, one group a year, aged twelve to fifteen; parents had to sign a paper agreeing to fifteen years of study abroad. In late summer 1872 the first thirty were ready to cross the Pacific.

paras.zh: 到了新英格兰，分歧先出现在日常小事上。容闳列出他与陈兰彬反复争执的事项：学生的学费和零用、假期开销、改换服装、参加家庭礼拜、去主日学和教堂、户外运动和球类。容闳说，他夹在中间当“缓冲”，为学生的合理要求辩护。
paras.en: In New England the disagreements began with everyday things. Yung Wing lists the matters he and Chen Lanbin fought over: the students' school and personal expenses, vacation expenses, their change of dress, attending family worship, Sunday school and church, and outdoor exercise and athletic games. Yung says he had to stand as "a kind of buffer" between Chen and the students.

paras.zh: 1876年秋，Woo Tsze Tung 接任监督。以下都出自容闳的转述：此人一上任就处处挑错，又不当面提出，而是不断向北京写信，说学生管理失当、被容闳纵容，模仿美国学生搞体育，玩多学少，结成宗教和政治性质的秘密团体，不听新监督的话，许多人上教堂、成了基督徒，再这样下去会忘了自己的国家；越早解散、全部撤回，对中国越好。容闳还说此人一向被朋友们“视为怪人”——这是当事一方的敌意描述。
paras.en: In the autumn of 1876 Woo Tsze Tung became commissioner. What follows is Yung Wing's account. Woo found fault with everything and, instead of raising it with Yung, sent a stream of letters to Peking: the students had been mismanaged and petted by Yung; they imitated American students in athletics and played more than they studied; they formed secret societies, religious and political; they ignored the new commissioner; most went to church and had become Christians; left alone they would lose their love of their country; and the "sooner this educational enterprise was broken up and all the students recalled, the better it would be for China". Yung adds that Woo "was regarded by all his friends as a crank", a hostile description from an interested party.

paras.zh: 军校申请碰壁后，Woo 再次发力，据容闳说，这一次有陈兰彬暗中配合。一位御史借美国的排华情绪上奏，请求解散留学事务、撤回全部学生。朝廷先征询李鸿章，他同意撤回；再问陈兰彬，他认为学生在美已经够久；Woo 主张立即撤回、回国后严加看管。容闳则被完全排除在征询之外。1881年，约一百名学生全部回国。
paras.en: After the academies' refusal, Woo renewed his efforts, this time, Yung says, with Chen Lanbin's secret co-operation. A censor, taking advantage of anti-Chinese feeling in America, asked the throne to break up the Mission and recall all the students. The court asked Li Hongzhang first, and he agreed. Chen Lanbin judged that the students had been in America long enough. Woo said they should be recalled without delay and closely watched after their return. Yung was "ruled out of the consultation altogether". In 1881 about a hundred students returned to China.

paras.zh: 美国的教师和监护人们联名抗议。除了“正要收获”那一句，他们还写道：“我们尚未完成交给我们的工作”，成果却在完成之前就被否定；至于学生若忘了中文，“我们从未承担教他们母语的责任”。这封信，我们今天是通过容闳书中的转载读到的。
paras.en: The students' American teachers and guardians protested. Besides the line about the harvest, they wrote: "We have not finished the work which we were expected to perform." Why should the results "be judged unfavorably before it could possibly be finished"? As for any neglect of Chinese, "we never assumed the duty of instructing them in it". We can read the letter today only because Yung Wing reprinted it in his book.

paras.zh: 记住一个具体的人：詹天佑。据1917年的《游美同学录》，他同治十一年（1872）以官费赴美，光绪四年（1878）进耶鲁大学（原书作“耶路大學”）学土木工程，光绪七年（1881）得学士学位，以数学成绩获奖，同年回国。回国后，他先被安排进福州船政局的水师学堂；从光绪十四年（1888）起，才历任京张铁路等多条铁路的工程师、总工程师。
paras.en: Keep one person in mind: Zhan Tianyou. According to the 1917 alumni record, he went to America on a government scholarship in 1872, entered Yale in 1878 to study civil engineering, took his bachelor's degree in 1881 with a prize for mathematics, and returned to China that same year. He was first placed at the naval school of the Fuzhou shipyard. Only from 1888 did he hold engineering posts on the railways, eventually as chief engineer on the Peking–Kalgan line and others.

paras.zh: 这不是一个人的决定。容闳记下的是一条链：监督的报告、军校的拒绝、御史的奏折、朝廷对三位官员的征询。一种解释是（作者推断）：决定所依据的，主要是学生“变成了什么样的人”，而不是他们学会了什么；最能说明学业的人——容闳和美国的教师们——都不在征询之列。不过清廷撤回的奏折原文本篇没有取得，决策者当时究竟怎样权衡，现有材料证明不了。
paras.en: This was not one person's decision. What Yung records is a chain: the commissioner's reports, the academies' refusal, the censor's memorial, the court consulting three officials. One interpretation, the author's, is that the decision turned mainly on what kind of people the students were becoming, not on what they had learned, and that those best placed to speak to their studies, Yung Wing and the American teachers, were not among those consulted. But this article has not obtained the Qing memorials on the recall, and the material we have cannot show how the decision-makers actually weighed the question.

paras.zh: 另一点是时间。按原计划，学生要在美国读十五年；召回时，最早一批去了大约九年。詹天佑恰好赶上毕业，而他学到的本事，又过了七年才用上。长期投入最容易在“快见效、还没见效”的时候被叫停——这是作者的观察，不是史料的结论。
paras.en: The other point is timing. The plan called for fifteen years; when the recall came, the first group had been in America about nine. Zhan Tianyou happened to graduate just in time, and even then his training waited seven more years to be put to use. Long-term investments are most easily stopped when they are close to paying off but have not yet done so; that is the author's observation, not a finding of the sources.

paras.zh: 一个新组建的数据团队，产出要九个月后才看得见，公司却按惯例在第三个月做评估。评估人看到的是“还没做出东西”，外加几件不合群的小事。可以先做一件事：项目开始时就写下“什么时候、用什么指标算见效”，并请最了解工作内容的人参加评估，别让中途的印象替代约定的指标。
paras.en: A newly formed data team will not show results for nine months, but the company reviews it at three, as usual. The reviewers see "nothing delivered yet" plus a few awkward habits. One thing to do first: at the start, write down when the work should count as paying off and by which measures, and have the people who best understand the work sit in on the review, so that mid-course impressions do not replace the agreed measures.

paras.zh: 现代虚构场景：一支团队外派培训，学员业余扎进行业社群，有人担心“心散了”。可以借的做法是把“行为变化”和“能力损失”分开：前者要看是否影响事先约定的产出，后者用可核对的证书、项目、考试成绩说话；写评估结论时，注明哪些是记录、哪些是印象。
paras.en: Modern fictional scenario: a team is sent out for training, the participants spend their spare time in industry communities, and some people worry their "minds have scattered." One method worth borrowing is to separate "behavior change" from "capability loss": the first is judged by whether it affects the outputs agreed in advance; the second is argued with checkable certificates, projects and exam results. When writing up review conclusions, state which parts are records and which are impressions.

paras.zh: 本篇关于撤回经过与理由的叙述，主要来自容闳1909年的回忆录，他是当事一方，对陈兰彬与 Woo Tsze Tung 带有强烈敌意；清廷撤回奏折的原文本篇未取得。“Woo Tsze Tung 一般认为即吴子登”这条对应关系，本证据包没有直接证明，只能列为待核实背景。美国排华氛围同样是容闳的描述，波特抗议信的文本也只见于容闳书中的转载。所以“为什么撤回”这个问题，现有材料给出的是一面之词加一封抗议信，不足以定论，更不宜当作组织决策的范本。
paras.en: The account of the recall and its reasons comes mainly from Yung Wing's 1909 memoir. He was one of the parties involved and was strongly hostile to Chen Lanbin and Woo Tsze Tung. The Qing court's own memorials on the recall were not obtained for this article. That Woo Tsze Tung was the official known in Chinese as Wu Zideng is generally accepted but is not shown by this evidence, so it is listed as background to be verified. The anti-Chinese atmosphere in America is likewise Yung Wing's description, and the protest letter survives here only as he reprinted it. On why the students were recalled, then, the material offers one side's account and one protest letter. That is not enough for a verdict, and certainly not a model for organisational decisions.

reflection.type: 不确定下决策（项目中途如何评估）

scenario.zh: 一家公司的三年期数据工程外派培养计划进行到第二年半，业务线主管反映学员“文化上不像自己人”，而学员刚要进入核心项目。
scenario.en: A company's three-year data-engineering overseas training program is two and a half years in. The business line head reports that the participants "don't feel like one of us culturally," while the participants are just about to enter core projects.

question.zh: 中途评估一个长期培养计划时，如果“是否融入组织文化”和“专业产出何时兑现”指向相反结论，该以什么证据决定继续、收缩还是叫停？谁有资格下这个判断？
question.en: When reviewing a long-term training program mid-way, if "does it fit the organizational culture" and "when will professional output pay off" point to opposite conclusions, on what evidence should we decide to continue, cut back, or stop? Who is qualified to make that judgment?

assumptions.zh: 计划目标是培养能独立负责核心系统的人才，三年为约定期限，已有两年半的过程数据；文化感受主要是印象，专业产出有可核对的记录。
assumptions.en: The program's goal is to develop people who can independently take charge of core systems; three years is the agreed term, and two and a half years of process data already exist. The cultural impressions are mostly impressions; the professional output has checkable records.

steps.zh: 先把两类指标分开列：可核对的产出（交付、考核、证书）与主观印象（“像不像自己人”），分开计分；让用人方、执行方、学员三方到场陈述；最后设定明确的兑现时间点和止损线，再决定是否继续。
steps.en: First list the two kinds of indicators separately: checkable output (deliverables, assessments, certificates) and subjective impressions ("are they like us"), scored separately. Have the hiring side, the implementing side and the participants all state their cases at the meeting. Finally, set a clear payoff point and a stop-loss line before deciding whether to continue.

alternative.zh: 另一种合理选择是立即收缩、只留少数人走完最后半年：理由是文化摩擦已经影响团队协作，即便专业产出即将兑现，组织代价也可能太高。这是作者提出的替代方案。
alternative.en: Another reasonable option is to cut back right away and keep only a few people for the last six months: the reason being that the cultural friction has already affected teamwork, and even if the professional output is about to pay off, the organizational cost may be too high. This alternative is proposed by the author.

uncertainty_note.zh: 撤回奏折原文本篇未取得；撤回的经过与理由主要出自容闳（Yung Wing）1909年回忆录，他是当事一方，对陈兰彬与 Woo Tsze Tung 有强烈敌意，其转述的 Woo 报告内容、御史奏请的动机、美国排华氛围均未经独立佐证。波特等人的抗议信文本经容闳书转载，未见原件。Woo Tsze Tung 一般认为即吴子登，但本证据包未直接证明该对应，列为待核实。詹天佑履历出自1917年《游美同学录》，为单一来源；其1881年获耶鲁土木工程学士、同年回国属该书记载（光绪七年）。陈兰彬与容闳争执事项的列举出自容闳单方记述。人名对应：陈兰彬即容闳书中的 Chin Lan Pin，《清史纪事本末》误作“陳蘭斌”，并把容闳误作“容閑”；这类对应属通行考订，非本篇证据直接给出。
uncertainty_note.en: The original text of the recall memorial was not obtained for this piece. The course of and reasons for the recall come mainly from Yung Wing's 1909 memoir; he was one of the parties involved and was strongly hostile to Chen Lanbin and Woo Tsze Tung. The contents of Woo's reports as retold by him, the censor's motives for his memorial, and the anti-Chinese atmosphere in America are all uncorroborated by independent sources. The text of the protest by Porter and others survives only as reprinted in Yung Wing's book; no original has been seen. Woo Tsze Tung is generally taken to be Wu Zideng, but this evidence packet does not directly establish the identification, so it is listed as to be verified. Zhan Tianyou's record comes from the 1917 Record of Students Returned from America, a single source; his 1881 Yale bachelor's degree in civil engineering and his return home the same year are as recorded there (seventh year of Guangxu). The list of disputes between Chen Lanbin and Yung Wing comes from Yung Wing's one-sided account. Name identifications: Chen Lanbin is Yung Wing's "Chin Lan Pin"; the Qing history spells him 陳蘭斌 and Yung Wing 容閑, both slips. These identifications follow standard scholarship and are not stated in the evidence itself.

sources.citation: Yung Wing (容闳), My Life in China and America (New York: Henry Holt, 1909), ch. 17 and 19 (Wikisource transcription, retrieved 2026-10-30); ch. 19 reprints the protest of President Porter of Yale and others

what.zh: 容闳自述留学计划如何结束，含美国教育者抗议信全文；立场鲜明，读时注意他是当事一方。
what.en: Yung Wing's own account of the end of the Mission, with the full protest letter; read it as one party's side.

what.zh: 可以逐个查到当年留美学生回国后做了什么，中英对照的小传。
what.en: Short bilingual biographies showing what individual returned students went on to do.
